name: What types of materials are commonly used for decorative millwork?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are commonly used for decorative millwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for decorative millwork include solid wood (like oak, maple, or poplar), medium-density fiberboard (MDF), and polyurethane. Solid wood offers natural grain, durability, and can be stained, while MDF is a cost-effective, smooth option ideal for painting. Polyurethane is moisture-resistant and durable, suitable for bathrooms or exterior applications. The choice of material is a key decision factor, as it impacts the finish, longevity, and maintenance requirements of the millwork. For instance, solid wood requires more careful moisture control than polyurethane.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common millwork materials are solid wood, MDF, and polyurethane, each offering different aesthetics, durability, and cost benefits.
